title: tofieldia palustris
intro: Tofieldia palustris, commonly known as marsh marigold, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the lily family (Liliaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Tofieldia palustris include expectorant, diuretic, and vulnerary effects, making it a potential remedy for coughs, colds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its pharmacological activities.
